in_hebrew.name: Oma
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Oma הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Oma is a nymph who personified the maternal, nurturing aspect of the earth. The name Oma is derived from the Greek word 'oma' meaning 'mother' or 'grandmother'. In Christianity, Oma is a name associated with maternal love, care, and nurturing.
